questions.question_english: 34. Arrange the construction of the following imperial Mughal monuments in the correct chronological order:
questions.explanation_english: The chronological construction sequence of these Mughal monuments begins with Humayun’s Tomb in Delhi, completed in 1572 CE. Buland Darwaza at Fatehpur Sikri was erected by Akbar in 1575 CE to celebrate his victorious conquest of Gujarat. The Taj Mahal in Agra was commissioned by Shah Jahan in 1632 and finished around 1648. Moti Masjid inside Agra Fort was completed later under Shah Jahan in 1654.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सम्राट मुग़ल स्मारकों का कालानुक्रमिक निर्माण क्रम इस प्रकार है: सबसे पहले, हुमायूँ का मकबरा 1572 ईस्वी में दिल्ली में पूरा हुआ। इसके बाद, बुलंद दरवाज़ा 1575 ईस्वी में अकबर द्वारा गुजरात पर विजय के उपलक्ष्य में फ़तेहपुर सीकरी में बनाया गया। ताज महल का निर्माण शाहजहाँ द्वारा 1632 में शुरू हुआ और यह 1648 में पूरा हुआ। अंत में, आगरा किले के भीतर मोती मस्जिद का निर्माण शाहजहाँ के तहत 1654 में पूरा हुआ।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) 1 - 2 - 3 - 4
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The chronological construction sequence of these Mughal monuments begins with Humayun’s Tomb in Delhi, completed in 1572 CE.

Which traditional textile craft, recognized for its use of natural dyes, castor oil treatments, and intricate double ikat motifs on unbleached cotton, has been awarded a Geographical Indication (GI) tag representing the heritage of Telangana?
questions.explanation_english: Telia Rumal is a distinctive traditional handloom art from Telangana that holds a Geographical Indication (GI) tag. The unique process involves treating unbleached cotton yarn with castor oil and ash before resist tie-dyeing, which creates intricate double ikat geometric motifs. Historically, it has been used as headscarves and lungis, and the oil treatment imparts natural water resistance, softening properties, and a characteristic aroma to the woven fabric.

questions.question_english: 78. Which traditional tribal fair held in Telangana near the Edupayala Vana Durga Bhavani temple takes place at the confluence of three streams of the Manjeera River?
questions.explanation_english: Edupayala Jatara is a major traditional tribal fair celebrated during Maha Shivaratri at Nagasanpalli in Medak district, Telangana. The shrine of Edupayala Vana Durga Bhavani is situated at the precise site where the River Manjeera divides into seven distinct rivulets (Edu Payalu). involves creating stacks of seasonal flowers
in concentric rings representing the mother
goddess?
questions.explanation_english: Bathukamma is a vibrant floral festival celebrated primarily by women in Telangana during Navratri. The celebration involves arranging colorful seasonal flowers, such as Thangedu, Gunugu, Chamanthi, and Katla, in concentric circular layers forming a conical tower representing Goddess Maha Gauri. Women sing folk songs and perform traditional dances around the flower stack before immersing it in local water bodies at dusk.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। बाटुकम्मा एक जीवंत फूलों का त्योहार है जो मुख्य रूप से तेलंगाना में नवरात्रि के दौरान महिलाओं द्वारा मनाया जाता है। इस उत्सव में थंगेडु, गुंगु, चमंती और कटला जैसे रंग-बिरंगे मौसमी फूलों को समवर्ती गोलाकार परतों में व्यवस्थित किया जाता है, जो देवी महा गौरी का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं। महिलाएँ फूलों के ढेर के चारों ओर लोक गीत गाती हैं और पारंपरिक नृत्य करती हैं, फिर इसे शाम को स्थानीय जल निकायों में विसर्जित करती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Bathukamma

ranges that harbor exceptional biodiversity and

questions.explanation_english:

western coast was inscribed as a UNESCO
Natural World Heritage Site in 2012. Older

range represents one of the world’s eight “hottest

questions.question_english: 46. Arrange the following stages of Nagara Temple architectural evolution in chronological order:
questions.explanation_english: The evolution of Nagara temple architecture progressed through distinct structural phases. It began during the early Gupta period with flat-roofed square shrines having pillared porches. The second stage introduced covered ambulatory pathways and low curvilinear shikharas. The third stage realized fully developed Panchayatana layouts with elevated platforms and tall Latina towers. The final medieval stage featured sprawling temple clusters with ornate mandapas and elaborate relief carvings.

questions.question_english:
30. Consider the following architectural features of
Indo-Islamic monuments in the Deccan:
A. Extensive use of high plasterwork (stucco)
with floral and geometric designs.
B. Overhanging cornices and archways with
mortar construction.
C. Minarets integrated into the façade or corner
pillars.
D. Complete absence of domes and arches in
structural design.
Which of the statements given above are correct
features?
questions.explanation_english:
Indo-Islamic monuments of the Deccan, such as
those built by the Bahmani, Qutb Shahi, and Adil
Shahi dynasties, feature rich plasterwork (stucco)
with intricate floral and geometric motifs, wide
overhanging cornices (chhajjas), arches built with
lime mortar, and integrated minarets on facades.
These structures prominently incorporate
majestic domes, archways, and vaulted ceilings,
making statement D incorrect regarding their
total absence.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। दक्कन के इंडो-इस्लामिक स्मारक, जैसे कि बहमनी, कुतुब शाही और आदिल शाही राजवंशों द्वारा निर्मित, समृद्ध प्लास्टरवर्क (स्टुको) के साथ जटिल फूलों और ज्यामितीय आकृतियों का उपयोग करते हैं, चौड़े ओवरहैंगिंग कॉर्निस (छज्जे), चूने के मोर्टार से बने मेहराब, और मुखौटों पर एकीकृत मीनारें। ये संरचनाएँ भव्य गुंबदों, मेहराबों और गुंबददार छतों को प्रमुखता से शामिल करती हैं, जिससे कथन D उनके पूर्ण अभाव के संबंध में गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A, B and C only
